== Notes ==

* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable [[corpse]]. 
* It deals [[cold damage]] with [[attack]]s, which use less than normal wand or spell range.
* It will cast hexes on multiple [[target]]s.
* At level 20 (rank 5) it has 15 in [[Water Magic]].

{{anomaly|The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon ''per player''.}}

== Trivia ==
* The summoned creature is a result of Asuran technology designed to imitate the creature it resembles.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
